tool.name: Bandage Image
tool.description: Generate an image of an assembly graph from a GFA file using Bandage-NG
tool.help:
# Bandage Image
Bandage-NG is a tool for visualizing assembly graphs from GFA files. This tool generates an image file of the graph visualization.
## Input
- **Input GFA file**: The GFA file containing the assembly graph.
## Output
- **Output image**: A PNG file showing the graph visualization.
For more details, visit the [Bandage-NG documentation](https://github.com/asl/BandageNG).
